name: SetWorkbookProperties
label: Set Workbook Properties (HTTP)
description: Sets metadata properties like Title, Author, and Keywords for a workbook.

fields.name: TenantId
fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.description: The Azure AD tenant identifier (e.g., 'contoso.onmicrosoft.com' or a GUID). Used to authenticate with Microsoft 365.

fields.name: ClientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Application (Client) ID of the Azure AD app registered to access Microsoft Graph.

fields.name: ClientSecret
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The client secret of the Azure AD application. Ensure it has the necessary permissions (e.g., Files.ReadWrite.All).

fields.name: DriveId
fields.label: Drive ID
fields.description: The unique ID of the OneDrive or SharePoint document library drive where the workbook is stored.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The relative path to the Excel file in the drive (e.g., 'Reports/AnnualReport.xlsx').

fields.name: Title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: The document title to set in the workbook's metadata (e.g., 'Q3 Financial Summary').

fields.name: Author
fields.label: Author
fields.description: The author name to embed in the workbook's properties (e.g., 'Finance Team').

fields.name: Keywords
fields.label: Keywords
fields.description: Comma-separated keywords for document indexing and search (e.g., 'finance, quarterly, 2024').
